name: The Inquisition
about: A pious lord's confessor starts hunting heretics, and his pyres creep from hedge-witches to a great house's own household, then to the King's court. Rein in the Faith and be called godless, or let it burn and watch whom it burns next.
title: The Inquisition

new.name: Brother {first}
new.memory: The gods showed me the rot in this realm, and gave me fire to cut it out.

goal.text: Burn the heresy out of every house, however high

beats.speaker: inquisitor
beats.text: {inquisitor}, confessor to {patron}, burns a herbwife in {pyre}'s market for speaking to the dead. Before she dies she names the women of {accused}'s household as her customers.

court.text: {accused} of {accused.house}: "A mad friar burns women in my own town, Your Grace, and now he wants my household. Leash him."

options.label: Forbid trials by the Faith in {pyre}
options.result: The King's writ forbids the friar's trials in {pyre}. {inquisitor} preaches that night on kings who shelter witches.

options.label: Send royal justices to try any charge (100 gold)
options.hint: the King's law, not the friar's
options.result: Royal justices ride for {pyre}, with orders that nobody burns without the King's seal.

options.label: The Faith may try its heretics
options.result: {inquisitor} has the King's leave. He builds a larger pyre.

beats.speaker: inquisitor
beats.text: Leashed in {pyre}, {inquisitor} preaches in every other town instead. The crowds grow, and his sermons name the King as the heretics' shield.

beats.speaker: inquisitor
beats.text: Under the rope, {accused}'s steward confesses to everything he is asked: the herbwife, the black candles, a goat in the cellar. {inquisitor} demands {accused} answer for {accused.his} household.

court.text: {patron} of {patron.house}: "The confession is sworn, Your Grace. If a great lord can shelter witches, so can anyone. Let the Faith have {accused}."

options.label: Throw out the confession: it was taken by the rope
options.result: The King's justices free the steward, what is left of him. {inquisitor} curses the court from the steps.

options.label: Let the Faith try {accused}
options.result: {accused} is summoned to answer before the friars. {accused.He} does not go.

options.label: Send {inquisitor} to preach overseas (300 gold)
options.result: A ship, a mission to the heathen isles, and a heavy purse for the abbey. {inquisitor} goes, preaching to the sailors.

beats.speaker: inquisitor
beats.text: The pyres spread from {pyre} to every town {patron} holds. Then {inquisitor} names a lady of the King's own household, and the court goes very quiet.

beats.speaker: inquisitor
beats.text: From the steps of the great sept, {inquisitor} declares the King accursed, and every oath sworn to him void in the sight of the gods. {patron} sends no word to Kingsmere at all.

court.text: {patron}: "The Faith has spoken, Your Grace. I would hear the King speak back, and choose his words with care. If he says nothing, the realm will take his silence for guilt."

options.label: Walk barefoot to the sept and do penance (500 gold)
options.result: The King walks barefoot through the snow to the great sept and kneels at {inquisitor}'s feet. The ban is lifted, and the friar's power has no ceiling now.

options.label: Arrest {inquisitor} for treason
options.hint: {patron.houseName} −30 · the Faith has a martyr or a prisoner
options.result: Royal guards drag {inquisitor} from the sept steps in front of the crowd. {patron} rides home without a word.

beats.speaker: patron
beats.text: The King says nothing to the ban, and his silence is taken for guilt. One by one the great houses send back their oaths, sealed with the sept's mark.

do.fall: Released from their oaths by the Faith, the great houses stop answering the King's summons. {patron} rides into Kingsmere with {inquisitor} beside {patron.him}, and the King is led out to the sept to answer for his soul.

beats.speaker: accused
beats.text: Hunted by the friars and abandoned by the crown, {accused} burns the sept at {pyre} and marches on Kingsmere, swearing to hang every priest who stands between {accused.him} and the throne.

beats.speaker: patron
beats.text: {patron} takes up the friar's cause and the friar's cross, and marches on Kingsmere to free {inquisitor} and cleanse the throne.

beats.speaker: inquisitor
beats.text: The crown endures, and kneels. The Faith's courts sit in every town now, and the King signs the warrants {inquisitor} sends him.

beats.speaker: accused
beats.text: The fires go out. The market at {pyre} is swept, and the stakes are cut up for firewood. Nobody in the realm says the word heresy above a whisper for a generation.
